name: DJControl Inpulse 200 Mk3
source: Capture 2026-10-07 (captures/inpulse.log); MK3 panel from Sweetwater's top-view photo; numbering seeded from Mixxx's original-Inpulse-200 mapping — [MIXXX] marks entries not yet seen on this unit

groups.comment: measured 2026-10-07: every number here was seen on this unit. MK3 panel (Sweetwater photo): LOOP (vinyl on shift), STEMS music + mic, SHIFT, HOT CUE (loop on shift), FX (sampler on shift), SYNC, CUE, PLAY, headphone (pfl), LOAD. 0x03 = LOOP (measured 2026-10-16, captures/inpulse-2026-10-16-loop.log; held = loop record); 0x09 = STEMS music (note icon), 0x0A = STEMS mic (measured 2026-10-16, captures/inpulse-2026-10-16-stems.log). Pad modes, captured: after HOT CUE (0x0F) the pads send 0x00-0x03 (hotcuePads), after FX (0x10, SHIFT up) 0x10-0x13 (rollPads)

[MIXXX] SHIFT held, original-200 numbering (0x94 notes). No shifted button was captured on the MK3; only the shifted jog (0xB4 09) shows the +3 channel shift. loopIn/loopOut are the original 200's names: on the MK3 0x09/0x0A are LOOP/STEMS buttons. 0x08 is shifted jog touch (jog profile). 0x03 = SHIFT+LOOP (VINYL on the panel): measured 2026-10-16

hot-cue mode (after HOT CUE): pads 1 and 3 measured (0x00, 0x02), 2 and 4 [MIXXX] Pads number along the rows (1 2 / 3 4) but their notes run down the columns: pad 1 = the first note, pad 3 the second, pad 2 the third, pad 4 the fourth (measured 2026-10-16, captures/inpulse-2026-10-16-looppads.log).

[MIXXX] SHIFT + pad in hot-cue mode; never captured Pads number along the rows (1 2 / 3 4) but their notes run down the columns: pad 1 = the first note, pad 3 the second, pad 2 the third, pad 4 the fourth (measured 2026-10-16, captures/inpulse-2026-10-16-looppads.log).

FX mode on the MK3, measured on both decks: the pads sent 0x10-0x13 only after FX (0x10) was pressed with SHIFT up (captures/inpulse.log). The id comes from Mixxx's original-200 ROLL range and is kept because sessions and tests name it; the MK3 has no ROLL button Pads number along the rows (1 2 / 3 4) but their notes run down the columns: pad 1 = the first note, pad 3 the second, pad 2 the third, pad 4 the fourth (measured 2026-10-16, captures/inpulse-2026-10-16-looppads.log).

[MIXXX] original-200 FX-mode numbers (0x20-0x23), never captured on the MK3: its FX button gives 0x10-0x13 (rollPads); 0x28-0x2B turned out to be LOOP pad mode (loopPads) Pads number along the rows (1 2 / 3 4) but their notes run down the columns: pad 1 = the first note, pad 3 the second, pad 2 the third, pad 4 the fourth (measured 2026-10-16, captures/inpulse-2026-10-16-looppads.log).

0x28-0x2B measured 2026-10-16 (captures/inpulse-2026-10-16-looppads.log): the MK3's LOOP pad mode (SHIFT + HOT CUE) sends them; pressing pads 1-4 in panel order gave 0x28, 0x2A, 0x29, 0x2B. pad-mode select, done in hardware: after HOT CUE the pads send their hot-cue notes (0x00-0x03), so the press itself needs no action
pad-mode select, done in hardware: after FX the pads send 0x10-0x13 (rollPads, captured), so the press itself needs no action
